text:
Good evening gate team,
A new handler sent an update on seating plans

Thanks for keeping an eye on the companion side tonight. The Companion Animal Travel Desk appreciates the steady coordination from the gate team, especially when carrier swaps and calm handoffs need a little extra care. Please keep your usual warm tone with travelers and remind everyone that our ground team is ready to move carriers carefully between services.

For the upcoming cat check-in, <<FACT F067>> Please treat that detail as confirmed and guide the traveler gently if they ask for a repeat. If Samuel Tanaka or Mateo Lee comes through with Skye, a quick reassurance and a clear path to the counter will help the whole process feel smooth. If anything looks off with labels, bedding, or approval papers, flag it right away so we can sort it before boarding.

On the larger-dog side, <<FACT F057>> Please share that in plain language if the traveler needs a reminder, and keep the handoff calm and simple. We have seen good results when the gate team stays patient, checks the carrier or lead setup, and lets the animal settle before the next step. Thank you for the steady support and for keeping Aurelia Skyways caring and organized for every traveler.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
